scientific_explanation: Uploaded GeoTIFF 'optical_rgb_check.tif' is a 3-band uint8 optical RGB raster without calibrated SAR radar polarizations (VV/VH) or backscatter (dB / gamma0). Optical RGB bands cannot be fed into SAR models (UNet_ResNet34, LightGBM_Pixel_Spatial, Log_Ratio_Baseline, CUSUM_Temporal).

incompatible_models_reasons.unet: Requires 5-channel calibrated SAR dB input [vv_pre_db, vh_pre_db, vv_post_db, vh_post_db, delta_vh_db].
incompatible_models_reasons.lightgbm: Requires 10-feature calibrated dual-pol SAR dB input.
incompatible_models_reasons.log_ratio: Requires calibrated pre-fire and post-fire SAR backscatter (VH or VV).
incompatible_models_reasons.cusum: Requires >= 3 co-registered multi-temporal SAR VH dB scenes.

warnings: Detected 3-band uint8 RGB optical raster (Band_1, Band_2, Band_3).
Sentinel-1/NISAR SAR GeoTIFF (float32 dB or calibrated linear gamma0/sigma0) is required.
